title: Didn't Work
text: Didn't Work. I was very excited to give this a try. I'm a 50+ menopausal woman and this summer has been tough! There have been many occasions where I wish I had something like this. Unfortunately, this one didn't work. When I first got it, I pressed the power button. In my experience, many items come already charged, so I thought I would give it a try. A blue light came on for about a second, I heard the start of the fan, and then the light went off and so did the fan. So I thought, maybe it wasn't fully charged. I charged it. At no time did any lights come on while charging, so I can only assume it was charging. After a couple of hours, I decided to try it again. I pressed the power button. The same thing happened. I put it down for a moment and reread through the instructions. Then I tried the button again. This time the fans sounded louder and a bit sickly, like it was croaking. It still wouldn't do anything for more than a second. At that time I decided to let my husband look at it. He's pretty good with technical stuff, so I thought it would be worth a shot. Unfortunately, nothing. Oh well......I will say that I did like the design of the fan. It flexes well so you can position it how you want. I cannot recommend it though because it didn't work.
